nodes.name:
set -eu
if [ -n "$EXPERIMENT" ]; then
  echo "[ci] EXPERIMENT explicitly set to '$EXPERIMENT' (override)"
else
  # Auto-detect from changed files. In MR pipelines GitLab exposes the
  # merge-base SHA directly (CI_MERGE_REQUEST_DIFF_BASE_SHA); use it
  # rather than a remote-tracking ref like origin/<branch>, which a
  # shallow CI clone does not populate. Outside MRs, fall back to the
  # previous commit. Detection is best-effort: any git failure (e.g. the
  # base commit is outside the shallow history) degrades to
  # DEFAULT_EXPERIMENT instead of aborting the job.
  if [ -n "${CI_MERGE_REQUEST_DIFF_BASE_SHA:-}" ]; then
    BASE="$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_DIFF_BASE_SHA"
    git fetch --depth=1 origin "$BASE" 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    BASE="HEAD~1"
  fi

  CHANGED_EXPS=$(git diff --name-only "$BASE" HEAD -- \
    '_support/benchmarking/experiments/' 2>/dev/null \
    | awk -F/ 'NF>=4 {print $4}' | sort -u || true)

  COUNT=$(echo -n "$CHANGED_EXPS" | grep -c '^' || true)

  if [ "$COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "[ci] No experiment dir changes (or base unavailable); using default: $DEFAULT_EXPERIMENT"
    EXPERIMENT="$DEFAULT_EXPERIMENT"
  elif [ "$COUNT" -eq 1 ]; then
    EXPERIMENT="$CHANGED_EXPS"
    echo "[ci] Auto-selected EXPERIMENT='$EXPERIMENT' from changed files"
  else
    echo "[ci] ERROR: multiple experiments changed:"
    echo "$CHANGED_EXPS" | sed 's/^/  - /'
    echo ""
    echo "Only one experiment can run per job. Re-trigger this manual"
    echo "job with EXPERIMENT=<name> set in the variables form to pick one."
    exit 1
  fi
fi
export EXPERIMENT
echo "EXPERIMENT=$EXPERIMENT" > experiment.env
